html:
To be able to program a series of photos without using a computer or being next to the telescope, I use a Canon TC-80N3 intervalometer. This accessory lets me program the taking of a series of photos.

To connect the TC-80N3 to the Rebel XTI, an adapter is needed. I ordered mine from this place. Everything works perfectly.

Here is a photo of the TC-80N3 with the adapter.
